title: Tripo Animated Character
ownership: Original asset from the owner's Blender 3D Gallery.
notes: The SHA-256 identifies the raw development copy before replacement with the optimized export.
The optimized exports retain the same 65-joint Mixamo skeleton. Idle, walk, wave and nod were retargeted from the owner's girl visitor by joint name and shipped in the high-detail GLB.
The mall uses idle, walk and sit. It removes the walk clip's net horizontal root motion so collision-checked routes own travel.
